releaseNotes: 优化窗口保护状态：台前调度开启时，桌面前台运行的 App 统一显示绿色“使用中”，只有与“不处理”App 组成的侧边栏分组显示“台前调度分组保护中”；台前调度关闭时，屏幕可见的 App 也显示绿色“使用中”。同时提高强制退出确认按钮的文字对比度，并将主菜单由 410pt 加宽至 440pt、搜索框由 174pt 加宽至 190pt，减少拥挤感。
releaseNotesEn: Refines window-protection statuses: with Stage Manager enabled, apps running in the foreground show green “In Use,” while only sidebar groups anchored by an Ignore app show “Protected by Stage Manager Group.” With Stage Manager disabled, visible apps also show green “In Use.” This release also improves the Force Quit confirmation button’s text contrast and widens the main menu from 410 pt to 440 pt and the search field from 174 pt to 190 pt to reduce crowding.
